t: Paint the dawn sky crimson over Leprechaun Village
title: Paint the dawn sky crimson over Leprechaun Village
name: Paint the dawn sky crimson over Leprechaun Village
description: The Rainbow Sentinel can paint the dawn sky crimson over Leprechaun Village. The Sentinel works it under the Absolute Light-Angle Mandate, bending all gloom into harmless light at 42 and 51 degrees - a Signature tale, not a real device.
